item.title: Comment on President Donald Trump Accomplishments by Lucie
item.description: Response to Elizabeth Tubonjic - May I print and share the prayer that you wrote with family members, friends and even on my websites when they are updated so that we can stand in agreement? I felt the Lord's power in that prayer and it's my heart's desire to keep that power continually moving. He isn't our president but that doesn't mean that we don't support him spiritually. Just like in your country, ours is also divided regarding the support and love that he needs to remain in this position
